info.name: Auto Shop POS API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Auto Shop POS (Car Showroom / Warehouse / Supplier POS system).

## Authentication
- Call **POST /api/v1/admin/login** with valid credentials to get a token.
- Token is automatically saved to the `token` environment variable via the login test script.
- All protected routes use `Bearer {{token}}` in the Authorization header.

## Permissions
- `owner` — full access to everything
- `admin` — most CRUD operations
- `cashier` — limited to order creation, reading inventory, sales reports

## Environment Variables
- `baseUrl` — API base URL (default: http://localhost:5000)
